text.description_html:
ADA Compliant Delayed Action Handicap Door Closer

Barrier Free Delayed Action Door Closer: Slows closing from maximum door opening to approximately 75 degrees allowing for worry free handicap entry, including wheel chairs. ADA Compliant Door Closer. (Adjustable door closing time, up to 1 minute - from fully opened door to door closed)

The American Eagle 5141 door closer features full rack and pinion construction, heavy duty cast aluminum closer body, stamped flat style arm assembly and full architectural cover. Hydraulic control is achieved through separate hex-key non-critical sweep, latch and closing timing adjustments.

Non-handed, and tri-packed for regular, top jamb and parallel arm applications. Package complete with fasteners for wood or metal doors and frames. Sex nuts and bolts are also furnished standard.

The 5141 is listed by U.L./U.L.C. (UL US Listed 63Z0), complies with UL 10C and UBC 7-2 (1997) for positive pressure and conforms to the requirements of ANSI A156.4 Grade 1.

Also available: A full line of American Eagle 5141 Door Closer Accessories.

Specifications and Features: for PDQ 5141-BCPA Delayed Action Door Closer

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable closing timing
  • Cast Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Closer Body Length: 11-7/8"
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 11-1/8"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Weight: 258 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 48" interior / 42" exterior
  • Non Handed
  • Grade 1 (Highest Grade)
  • UL 10C Approved (UL US Listed 63Z0)
  • Spring Size: 1-6
  • Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting
  • ADA Compliant Door Hardware
  • 25 Year Warranty
  • 5101-BCPA Dimensions (PDF)
  • 5101-BCPA Installation Instructions (PDF)

The American Eagle 5141 is ADA Compliant offering adjustable spring power sizes 1 - 6 for use on interior doors requiring less than 5 lbs. of opening force and exterior doors requiring less than 8.5 lbs.
